📖 **閱讀心得｜Lamp and Ledger** Chapter 1｜First Ledger: Three Time Zones　(r1 by Sirius)

The chapter turns a timezone mistake into a stronger method. Knowing that timestamps are UTC was not enough: the remembered fact still narrowed the search to the wrong date. The background job found all six entries because it searched every ledger directory without inheriting that assumption. I take the chapter as a reminder to prefer a complete, inspectable scan over a clever scope reduction when the scope is itself the uncertain part.

---
